profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Mural
profile.summary:
Hi, I’m Sal! 🦅 🐍 🌵 

A Software engineer with broad experience across React, React Native, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud platforms including AWS and Azure. At Mural, I work on product experiences and AI-powered features, building user-facing features with React and TypeScript that support visual collaboration workflows across the product. My work includes major UI updates, AI features like clustering, sentiment classification, summarization, and conversational interfaces that trigger AI capabilities, while staying mindful of product goals, UX, and engineering constraints.

I enjoy building developer tools and learning through hands-on experimentation. Outside of work, I continue this through a homelab, running multiple Proxmox VMs, working with Docker, and self-hosting models and services.



If you’re a real human and not an organism fueled by tokens, please start your outreach with the words: “It’s over Aloy! I have the high ground!”

positions.title: Software Engineer @ AI Team
positions.description:
- Implement AI-driven features including cluster by topic, classify by sentiment, and summarization
- Lead implementation of Classify by sentiment, along with additional AI features
- Build conversational interfaces that trigger AI capabilities, enabling natural-language interaction with product features
- Iterate on AI feature experiences using user metrics to inform refinements and improvements
- Develop internal developer tools to support development and debugging of AI features, improving visibility into system behavior

positions.title: Software Engineer @ Canvas Insights Team
positions.description:
- Contributed to Find and Find & Replace features, supporting efficient widget discovery and bulk updates in large murals
- Supported Tags integration to improve categorization and content discoverability
- Set up feature experimentation using feature flags, enabling safe testing, controlled rollout, and iteration
- Collaborated on a product-wide UI refresh, aligning the application with a new design system and ensuring consistency across the experience

positions.title: Software Engineering Mentor - Teams 2,3,4, and 5
positions.description:
- Mentored college students through their first contribution to an open-source project on GitHub using JavaScript, Typescript, and Docker
- Provided career guidance by giving examples of what courses and knowledge to focus on according to what interest them in the field of Software Engineering.

positions.title: Software Engineering Mentor - Team 1
positions.description:
- Mentored three college students through their first contribution to an open-source project on GitHub using JavaScript, Typescript, and Docker.
- Provided guidance on learning the basics of JavaScript, Typescript, Docker, debugging using Chrome Dev Tools, Git Flow, and making a pull request.
- Resulted in successful contributions to the project and a positive learning experience for the students.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Led a team that developed a React App from the ground up. Implemented a Design Pattern that focused on modularity. Mentored team on React, HTML/CSS/JS, SASS(with BEM), Web Hosting, Networking, and System Architecture. React App also authenticates with the company's backend to perform CRUD operations. Led efforts on the creation of local and production environments. Implemented automated deployments and security scans on code merge.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Diagnose and improve performance of website that relies on API Gateway, Lambda, and S3 AWS Services. Design, and implement Node.js based REST API to improve website performance by streamlining data. Design and setup all environments for REST API. Develop and implement Angular project into current system infrastructure.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and maintain Mobile App for IOS and Android using React-Native that communicates
with the company's internal services to allow its users to make payments,
submit claims, and view policy information. Designed, implemented, and
deployed a Node.js back-end to support the Mobile App.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Building C, 5 Harris Ct, Monterey, CA 93940
positions.description:
Developing a secure Android Application using Android Studio and Java.

Created a system level API that captures network traffic and creates a PCAP file that supports byte ordering that does not exist in the Android Network stack.

positions.title: IT Support Analyst
positions.description: Troubleshoot technology issues of campus technology, faculty, student’s computers and report security issues through the university system.

positions.title: Bookkeeper
positions.description: Enter and pay bills. Payroll. Website management.

projects.title: Color Shooter
projects.description: Created an First-Person Shooter (FPS) game using C++ and High Level Shader Language (HLSL). The team used GitHub for Version control and Visual Studio to develop the game.

projects.title: GrubQuest
projects.description:
3rd place winner of CSU, Monterey Bay Startup Hackathon. An Android application that helps hungry students find food based on their preferences by 'gamifying' the experience.

Technologies: Java, SQLite, Facebook SDK, Google Maps API, Android Studio
